defects: At 64 inches, the front deck and ladder overlap and read as one slatted base rather than an open nursery work bay with a distinct access ladder.
The structure remains a small object in the full Room A settlement view, so the nursery/workshop function is not fully clear.
Several close-range leaf and platform details collapse at normal settlement distance.
hard_fail_reasons: Luna pixel review finds the 64-inch work bay and ladder remain indistinct across settlement, opposite, and side views; this prevents the gameplay-readability gate from passing.
incumbent_comparison: v003 improves the gameplay read over v002: the brown trunk is visible, the larger ochre pods register as fruit, and dark foliage and plum accents survive. The entry ladder and front deck still merge at the 64-inch Room A camera.
next_action_hypothesis: For any future transfer, separate the access ladder from the front deck edge and open a clear gap between them; simplify the front work-surface outline and frame the empty bay with two high-contrast supports. Keep the corrected 26 x 10 x 18 inch envelope and retain the trunk and pod improvements.

observations.art_direction_fit: The living trunk, dark green/plum leaves, and ochre pods are more distinctly Verdant than v002. The work function still needs a clearer front opening at settlement scale.
observations.close_up_quality: The close view clearly shows a central trunk and separate fruit-like pods, but deck and ladder remain crowded and some leaves still read as paddles.
observations.gameplay_readability: Luna pixel review: in the 1280 x 720 view the object spans about x=555-715, y=330-440. The trunk at x=637-653, y=350-394 and pods at x=600-680, y=370-410 now register; deck and ladder overlap around x=590-680, y=395-435 and do not read as an open bay with access.
observations.geometric_detail: At close range the model shows a widened braided trunk, individual shaped leaves, larger seed pods, root supports, platform planks, and ladder rungs. At 64 inches the front work geometry merges.
observations.material_realism: Darkened green foliage, brown trunk and ochre pods separate better than v002 under Room A lighting; some leaf underside accents remain subtle.
observations.proportion: Godot validates 23.2637 x 9.5782 x 16.0840 inches against the 26 x 10 x 18 inch module envelope. The camera-scale deck and ladder proportions remain crowded.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot 4.7.2 technical validation passes with source bounds 23.2637 x 9.5782 x 16.0840 inches; all three ratios remain within the 20% tolerance for 26 x 10 x 18 inches.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The central brown stem and ochre pods now identify a cultivated tree better than v002, but the complete object still reads partly as a slatted platform at normal settlement distance.
observations.silhouette_quality: Dark green foliage, plum accents, brown trunk, and ochre pods create more separation. The open bay is not distinct from the front platform in the gameplay views.
observations.surface_variation: Raised veins, multiple leaf greens, plum accents, dark joins, and pod ridges are visible in close captures, with useful broad color blocks at 64 inches.
observations.technical_integration: The candidate loads through the review-only production resolver in Room A; nine Godot captures were registered. No room landmarks, construction behavior, or simulation geometry changed.

close_inspection.evidence: The close view clarifies the trunk and pods, but the front ladder still crowds the deck and the leaf forms remain broad paddles.

edge_treatment.evidence: Leaves have modeled edges and thick geometry; root ends and platform members have rounded transitions.

hardware.evidence: No metal hardware is needed for this living structure; rootwood joins connect the work platform and ladder.

joins.evidence: The widened trunk joins visible branching members; close view shows the platform and support roots assembled together.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: The access ladder overlaps the front deck, so the intended open work bay does not read at the 64-inch production camera.

material_response.evidence: Dark green leaves, brown wood, and ochre pods remain distinct under Room A lighting.

surface_variation.evidence: Close view shows raised veins, plum accents, pod ridges, and multiple living materials.

thickness.evidence: Individual leaves and bark members show physical thickness in the close render, though leaf forms are still broad.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: The close view reads as a stylized, assembled living structure with a trunk, raised work surface, root supports, ladder, foliage, and fruit pods.

photo_character.evidence: The ArtBrief has no photo reference or source-resemblance requirement.

visual_transfer_diagnosis.corrective_action: If this asset is revisited, move the ladder forward and laterally away from the deck edge so there is a visible floor gap, reduce front slat clutter, and preserve an open framed work bay. Keep the current dark trunk, dark foliage, and larger front-facing ochre pods.
lost_visual_information: The front work-bay opening collapses into the slatted platform silhouette at 64 inches.
The ladder rungs overlap the deck edge and lose their access function in the settlement view.
Some leaf vein and underside accents disappear at game distance.
preserved_components: The corrected envelope passes Godot technical validation.
The main trunk and ochre pods now register in the settlement capture.
The review-only production integration preserves all simulation and RoomDefinition behavior.
